title: Live Load and Adaptive Offloading Validation

load_method.method: bounded CPU busy-loop workers launched through AWS Systems Manager; no deployment or pod scaling changes

end_to_end_inference.note: Generated test image; inference completed successfully with zero detections.

limitations: CPU pressure was generated with a bounded synthetic busy-loop, not a representative production user workload.
Only Low-priority workload was used for the live offload and recovery path.
The inference payload was a generated test image and returned zero detections; this validates routing and inference completion, not detection accuracy.
No sustained multi-hour stability or capacity ceiling claim is made.
